ctx.x: That’s precisely what I’m talking about Kimery: They’re grounded in the tradition of the music.

I see a frontier being pushed with Danilo and some of those guys. I see a frontier maybe being scouted out somewhere else, but I don’t see it – it’s not resonating the same way. That’s just my ear.
